name: OG Scary Baboon
summary: Welcome to OG-Scary Baboon, a chilling horror game that thrusts players into a nightmarish facility where escape is not a option. Set in a light, atmospheric environment, this game combines the elements of suspense, strategy, and adrenaline-pumping action. Players must navigate through treacherous hallways while evading various terrifying creatures in a desperate bid for survival.
